title: KnowledgeEngineeringWorkspace v1
description: The estate's sovereign Knowledge-Engineering + Dictionary-Engineering workbench contract — an IBM-Watson-Knowledge-Studio equivalent, governed. This is a COMPOSITION LAYER, not a new term schema: a KE Workspace binds documentSet -> annotations (CONSUMED from the regis-entity-graph semantic-role output, SemanticTokenTree #22/#27) -> entityTypes + relationTypes (REFERENCED into the governed registries: regis entity-class #16 / semantic-role-kind #22 / ontogenesis OWL/SHACL Domains) -> dictionaries whose entries are governed Systema Concept Entries (CONSUMED from ontogenesis Platform/Systema; source-anchored, promotion-state-lifecycled, revisioned — NOT static lookup lists) -> rules -> versions -> modelRef (rule-based + ML). Every artifact carries a provenance class {learned | human_authored | imported}; every promotion (annotation -> type/dictionary entry) and every human authorship event (add/overwrite/annotate/define) is receipted (proof-artifact-spine sha256: OR knowledge-state-lifecycle urn:srcos:receipt:; SHA-256 = FIPS-180-4 algorithm) and versioned by supersession (prior ConceptRevision retained). The teeth (validate_ke_workspace.py) enforce, both ways: a static-match dictionary entry (NO sourceAnchor / lifecycle skipped) is REJECTED (learn-don't-match); a type/rule referencing a type not in the governed registry is REJECTED; an annotation promoted with no receipt is REJECTED; a human overwrite with no author or no receipt is REJECTED.

documentSet.description: The corpus under annotation. WKS-supported doc types; keep docs small (~1-2k words).

annotations.description: Annotations CONSUMED from the regis-entity-graph semantic-role output (SemanticTokenTree token role, #22/#27) as candidate entity/relation/dictionary terms. A promoted annotation MUST carry a promotion receipt (KE-T4).

entityTypes.description: Entity-type bindings REFERENCED into the governed registries (regis entity-class #16, ontogenesis OWL/SHACL Domains). Consumed, not redefined (KE-T2).

relationTypes.description: Relation/role-type bindings REFERENCED into the governed registries (regis semantic-role-kind #22, epistemic-edge). Consumed, not redefined (KE-T2).

dictionaries.description: Governed dictionaries. mode MUST be 'governed'; a 'static_match' lookup dictionary is REJECTED (KE-T1, learn-don't-match). Each entry BINDS a governed Systema Concept Entry.

rules.description: Rule-based extractor rules. Each referenced entity/relation type MUST resolve to a governed binding in this workspace (KE-T3).

versions.description: Named workspace snapshot/version points. Each is receipted.

authorship.description: Governed human authorship events. The user is a first-class author: add/overwrite/annotate/define an entity-type, relation-type, dictionary-entry (Systema concept) or rule. Each event is author-attributed + versioned + receipted, and overwrites the learned layer by SUPERSESSION (prior ConceptRevision retained).

modelRef.description: The two models a KE version compiles to (WKS): a rule-based model + an ML model.

ruleBasedRef.description: Governed id of the compiled rule-based model.

mlModelRef.description: Governed id (e.g. analysis-views / ModelManifest) of the trained ML model.

Provenance.description: The provenance class carried by EVERY governed artifact. learned = produced by a context predictor and source-anchored (learn-don't-match); human_authored = authored by a first-class human author; imported = brought in from a governed external source. A receiptRef is always required (KE-T7/KE-T8).

learnedBy.description: REQUIRED when class=learned. The learned context predictor + its structural evidence that a term recurs coherently — NOT a static membership test (feedback_learn_dont_match_dictionaries).

evidence.description: Structural basis (context-coherence cosine, cross-domain concentration, k-gram TF-IDF persistence). Information structure, never a raw value.

sourceCorpusRef.description: Governed corpus id the term was learned from.

author.description: REQUIRED when class=human_authored. The first-class human author.

importedFrom.description: REQUIRED when class=imported. A governed external source (never a raw wordlist).

ReceiptRef.description: Reference to a governed receipt: a proof-artifact-spine ProofArtifact entryHash (sha256:<64hex>) OR a knowledge-state-lifecycle receipt id (urn:srcos:receipt:...). SHA-256 = FIPS-180-4 algorithm. KE-T8.

wordCount.description: Keep docs small (~1-2k words); a text doc over 2000 words is REJECTED (KE-T9).

TypeBinding.description: A binding that REFERENCES a governed entity/relation type in an estate registry — it does not redefine it (consume-not-fork). The validator recomputes membership against the pinned governed registries (KE-T2).

member.description: The member within that registry's governed enum (e.g. ORG, RELATION).

mode.description: MUST be 'governed'. A 'static_match' (WKS-style lookup) dictionary is REJECTED (KE-T1, learn-don't-match).

DictionaryEntry.description: A governed dictionary entry that BINDS a Systema Concept Entry (ontogenesis Platform/Systema — CONSUMED, authoritative source). It carries the governance PROJECTION the workbench teeth check against the Systema SHACL gate: a mandatory sourceAnchor (absence ⇒ a bare word/tag ⇒ static-match ⇒ REJECT, KE-T1), a promotionState from the Systema lifecycle, revision history (retained), and a provenance class. There is deliberately NO matchList/lookup/wordlist field: membership is decided by the source-anchored, learned/authored concept, not by literal string matching.

conceptRef.description: The bound Systema conceptId IRI (e.g. systema:concept:dictionary-doctrine). Authoritative record lives in ontogenesis.

roleLabel.description: Optional learned role symbol (regis SemanticRole.label convention, ContactLists) linking this dictionary entry to an annotation role.

roleKind.description: Optional link to the regis semantic-role-kind (#22) this entry types.

sourceAnchor.description: The Systema SourceAnchor projection — the learn-don't-match witness. REQUIRED: a dictionary entry with no sourceAnchor is a static word/tag, not a governed concept (KE-T1).

sourceRef.description: Governed source id/path the concept is anchored to.

promotionState.description: The Systema promotion lifecycle. Advancing past 'reviewed_definition' requires a reviewed sourceAnchor (KE-T1: no skipping the lifecycle).

implementationSurface.description: Systema implementationSurface — cross-repo binding {ownerRepo, surfacePath}. Required for implementation_linked+ (KE-T1).

revision.description: Systema ConceptRevision history (retained — a supersession never deletes prior revisions).

version.description: Workbench version counter over this conceptRef (max active = current).

supersedes.description: conceptRef@version of the prior entry this supersedes (prior retained).

status.description: Workbench activation state; exactly one active (non-superseded/tombstoned) version per conceptRef = max version (KE-T7).

Annotation.description: A reasoning-chain annotation CONSUMED from the regis semantic-role output (SemanticTokenTree token role, #22/#27), promoted through the governed KE loop into a candidate entity/relation/dictionary term.

role.description: Mirrors the regis SemanticRole: closed kind + OPEN LEARNED label + structural evidence.

promotedTo.description: If the annotation was promoted, what it became. A non-null promotedTo REQUIRES promotionReceiptRef (KE-T4).

ref.description: bindingId / conceptRef the annotation was promoted into.

Rule.description: A rule-based extractor rule. entityTypeRefs/relationTypeRefs MUST resolve to governed bindings in this workspace (KE-T3), which in turn resolve to the governed registries (KE-T2).

entityTypeRefs.description: bindingIds of entity-type bindings this rule references.

relationTypeRefs.description: bindingIds of relation-type bindings this rule references.

AuthorshipEvent.description: A governed human authorship event — the user acting as a first-class author over the learned layer. author + version + receiptRef are ALWAYS required (KE-T6). An 'overwrite' MUST carry 'supersedes' (prior ConceptRevision retained, KE-T5).

supersedes.description: ref@version of the prior artifact this overwrite supersedes (prior retained). REQUIRED for op=overwrite (KE-T5).
